name: Font
brief: Font loader class for managing custom fonts. Fonts are loaded globally and can be referenced by name in `Text` objects.

members.name: provider
members.brief: Set the font provider used when calling `Font.load()` without raw data.
description: The default provider fetches from the [fontsource](https://fontsource.org) CDN. Replace it to load fonts from your own CDN or any other source.

members.name: load
members.signature: static load(name: string, data: Uint8Array, options?: LoadFontOptions): void

params.name: name
params.description: Unique name to identify this font

members.name: load
members.signature: static load(name: string, options?: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<void>
members.brief: Auto-load a font using the configured font provider.
description: With the default `FontsourceProvider`, the name must match a fontsource package slug (e.g. `'poppins'`, `'open-sans'`).

params.name: name
params.description: Font name passed to the provider
